children: BSE shares rose 1.6 per cent to ₹3,147.50 on the NSE on Tuesday as the stock is set to replace Wipro in the Nifty 50 index. The rejig will take effect on September 30, 2026, following the close of trading on September 29. Wipro shares, meanwhile, declined close to 2 per cent to ₹158.80.

BSE’s inclusion in the Nifty 50 follows its six-month average free-float market capitalisation of ₹1,40,879 crore, compared with Wipro’s ₹55,930 crore. BSE qualified for inclusion as its average free-float market capitalisation was at least 1.5 times that of Wipro.
The reshuffle is expected to result in estimated passive inflows of $630 million into BSE, while Wipro is estimated to see passive outflows of $152 million.
The reshuffle will also bring changes to the Nifty 100 index, with BSE, Hitachi Energy India, Polycab India, Vedanta Aluminium Metal and Vodafone Idea being added.

The estimated passive inflows from the Nifty 100 changes are $620 million for BSE, $80 million for Hitachi Energy India, $95 million for Polycab India, $155 million for Vedanta Aluminium Metal and $68 million for Vodafone Idea.

title: BSE shares rise 1.6%, stock to replace Wipro in Nifty 50 reshuffle
